notes.code:
# 生成模型与判别模型：本学科基本原理演示
import numpy as np
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
real=rng.standard_t(5,size=500)
synthetic=rng.normal(real.mean(),real.std(),size=500)
for name,r in [("real",real),("synthetic",synthetic)]:
 print(name,"mean",r.mean(),"q01/q99",np.quantile(r,[.01,.99]))
 print("lag1",np.corrcoef(r[:-1],r[1:])[0,1])
notes.application: 用于金融大模型、文本检索增强、财经语料微调及市场收益情景生成。
